messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Triplet: ["capsule", "based on", "sertraline"]

The relation 'based on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is formulated or derived from the substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has composition': The subject entity contains or is composed of the component or material specified by the object entity.
B. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
C. 'has formulation': The subject drug is available in the specific formulation specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be used for': The subject entity can be used for the purposes or conditions specified by the object entity.
E. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
